commands: bcftools mpileup -f canonical_publication/references/selected/organelle_combined.fa -b canonical_publication/work/publication-20260817/variants/mitochondria.bam.list -R canonical_publication/references/masks/publication-20260817/mitochondria_high_confidence_sites.bed -d 250 -q 20 -Q 20 -a FORMAT/DP,FORMAT/AD -Ob -o canonical_publication/work/publication-20260817/variants/mitochondria.mpileup_likelihoods.bcf && bcftools call --ploidy 1 -m -a FORMAT/GQ -Ob -o canonical_publication/work/publication-20260817/variants/mitochondria.all_sites.bcf.uncorrected canonical_publication/work/publication-20260817/variants/mitochondria.mpileup_likelihoods.bcf && bcftools view -h canonical_publication/work/publication-20260817/variants/mitochondria.all_sites.bcf.uncorrected | sed 's/##INFO=<ID=MQ,Number=1,Type=Integer/##INFO=<ID=MQ,Number=1,Type=Float/' > canonical_publication/work/publication-20260817/variants/mitochondria.all_sites.bcf.header && bcftools reheader -h canonical_publication/work/publication-20260817/variants/mitochondria.all_sites.bcf.header -o canonical_publication/work/publication-20260817/variants/mitochondria.all_sites.bcf canonical_publication/work/publication-20260817/variants/mitochondria.all_sites.bcf.uncorrected && bcftools view -h canonical_publication/work/publication-20260817/variants/mitochondria.all_sites.bcf | grep -Fq '##INFO=<ID=MQ,Number=1,Type=Float' && rm -f canonical_publication/work/publication-20260817/variants/mitochondria.all_sites.bcf.uncorrected canonical_publication/work/publication-20260817/variants/mitochondria.all_sites.bcf.header

bcftools norm -f canonical_publication/references/selected/organelle_combined.fa -Ou canonical_publication/work/publication-20260817/variants/mitochondria.genotype_masked.all_sites.bcf | bcftools view -m2 -M2 -v snps -Ou | bcftools +fill-tags -Ou -- -t AC,AN,F_MISSING | bcftools view -i 'QUAL>=30 && F_MISSING<=0.2' -Oz -o canonical_publication/results/variants/publication-20260817/mitochondria.high_confidence_variant_sites.vcf.gz
